text:
chris: kicking off config-only deploy — routing bias + prefetch/batching soft-cap + timeout trim. no code changes. Deploy bot: https://deploys.redwood.internal/1898765432 :rocket:
chris: change window 23:00-00:00 PT. canary to 0.5% (tiny-slice) routed to warm nodes in us-west-2. model pinned to v2.3.1 for safety.
deploy-bot: rollout started: stage=canary pct=0.5 target=warm-pool-us-west-2 config=cfg/2026-03-21/prefetch-softcap.json
maria: what's the exact delta?
chris: request_timeout_ms 1250->950, max_batch_size 72->50, batching_window_ms 30->12, prefetch_kv_enabled=true, prefetch_ttl_ms=15000. routing: prefer_warm_nodes=true.
olga: last time prefetch helped cold starts but caused kv-store spike on tail. set alerts: p99 > baseline*1.4 OR kv_store_ops_increase > 20% sustained 6m triggers rollback.
chris: set auto-rollback rule per olga's thresholds. linking runbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/config-rollbacks. also scoped canary to tenants with <10qps.
deploy-bot: canary applied to warm-pool-us-west-2, pct=0.5, health checks running.
observability-bot: initial sample -> canary p50=95ms p95=260ms p99=510ms kv_ops_delta=+8% errors=0.01% cost_delta=-0.9%
maria: p99 looks fine. kv_ops +8% ok but monitor.
chris: progressing to 2% in 12m if stable; will bump to 10% after 30m.
oncall-bot: pager attached to #eng-oncall. escalation rule: oncall if rollback triggers.
olga: reminder: keep model pinned v2.3.1 for 48h post-full-rollout.
maria: putting a short release note: "Config-only: enable KV prefetch with 15s TTL, reduce request timeout to 950ms, lower max_batch_size to 50, shorten batching window to 12ms, bias routing to warm nodes in us-west-2. Scoped canary (0.5% -> 2% -> 10%). Auto-rollback on p99 or kv-store ops spike."
deploy-bot: canary stable at 0.5% for 15m. metrics: p95 delta -3ms, p99 stable, kv_ops +9%. advancing to 2%.
observability-bot: alerting: p99 and kv_ops monitors enabled; dashboards pinned.
chris: thanks — monitoring closely, will post final status on full rollout or if rollback fires. :thumbsup:
